changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Attribute') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Attribute]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [AttributeTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [InheritanceObjectType] [varchar](50) NULL, [InheritanceObjectID] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [DisplayValue] AS ([utility].[GetObjectDisplayValueWrapper]('Attribute',[ID],[AttributeTypeID])), CONSTRAINT [PK_Attribute] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Attribute_AttributeType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_AttributeType] FOREIGN KEY([AttributeTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AttributeType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_AttributeType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Attribute_ParentAttribute') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_ParentAttribute] FOREIGN KEY([ParentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Attribute] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_ParentAttribute] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Attribute_ObjectType-ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Attribute_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Attribute] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Attribute_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Attribute] AFTER DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON delete Asset where Object = 'Attribute' and ObjectID in (select ID from deleted);

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Attribute_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Attribute] AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON INSERT INTO [dbo].[Asset] ([AssetTypeID],[State],[Object],[ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy]) SELECT T.ID, 1, 'Attribute', O.ID, O.[UpdatedOn], O.[UpdatedBy], O.[UpdatedOn], O.[UpdatedBy] FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'AttributeType' and T.ObjectID = O.AttributeTypeID;

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[Attribute_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[Attribute] AFTER UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON update T set T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn from Asset T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'Attribute' and T.ObjectID = S.ID;
